description:
## Functional specifications and files
Read live Label/Labels, ResourceLabels, ValueManagement, Actions, Document/ExternalSource/ExternalPermissions, EntryCatalog and BO. Record module ownership, source identity and ancestry, validated dispatch contracts, migration baseline, affected tests and compatibility. Resolve API/data shapes before dependent implementation.
Files/owners: Existing modules only; planning evidence in this issue. No application edits.
## Tests to add before implementation
Compare existing catalog/resource/value/lifecycle/LiveView tests to revised contract; identify extensions and duplicate scenarios, report exact approval scope.
## Branches/paths validated
Success, invalid input, nil/denied actor, stale/concurrent write, unavailable/deleted source, lifecycle cleanup and failure rollback where relevant. No hidden cross-service calls.
## Mocking plan
Real Repo, validated Actions, NodeRouter and domain boundaries. Mock only external provider/conversion HTTP when relevant; runtime dependencies via existing Zaq.Config opts, no global mutation.
## Documentation
Update owner module docs and relevant existing service/BO guide alongside behavior; durable evidence here. Follow docs/documentation.md.
## Action reuse assessment
Local-only audit; existing SaveLabelDefinition, EditResourceLabels, UpdateLabelValues and delete Actions are extension candidates. Document.insert_new/1 and ExternalPermissions.apply/2 are ensure candidates, source authority must be verified. No new generic tool or parallel tree.
## Validation/dependencies
Read AGENTS.md, docs/agent-tools.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/testing-approach.md, docs/code-quality.md and applicable service guides. Scoped tests + mix q only per implementation issue. Final precommit reserved for final child. Supervisor verifies before closure. New feature E2E remains zaq-kw0.15 -> zaq-kw0.16.

comments.text: Three read-only Sol audits completed. Reuse confirmed: Labels definition/deletion; ResourceLabels editing/projection; AssignmentValue validation; ValueManagement delegates ResourceLabels; existing Actions validated by Jido.Exec and confidential Events. Canonical source ref is provider/config_id/record_id (Disk EntryCatalog UUID, remote opaque ID); derive source server-side. Get_file authorizes read, update authority must be checked separately. Disk permissions need list_permissions. Extend ExternalPermissions with strict checked mode reusing principal mapping, retain existing apply/2 defaults. No existing ancestry operation: add bounded authorized Channels record context; Disk delegates Storage EntryCatalog ancestry, remote get_file immediate-parent traversal, no separate tree. Multi-parent conflict/inaccessible ancestry fail closed without leaking labels. Polymorphic storage must preserve database integrity/cleanup/no-chunk availability; stale chunk ID reuse after dynamic reset needs protection. UI reuses existing LabelEditor/LabelValueManager/Chips; folders are configuration scope, NOT definition resource target. Source editor open/cancel read-only, ensure+edit only on Save. Existing tests to extend mapped by audit; exact free-text/blank/automatic-rejection changes requested from human and pending. Migration mapping pending user choice: current dev DB has 3 definitions/7 document assignments. Baseline isolated branch: 64 passed including 4 properties. No application edits.
